pipeline.heading: Engineered for Insurance Underwriting Precision
pipeline.subtitle: From raw PDF and scanned image ingestion to multi-dimensional contract verification.

pipeline.step2Desc: Extract policyholder, dates, financial sums, deductibles, and covenants via Optical Intelligence.

trust.heading: Trust & Transparency by Design
trust.subtitle: Built with financial-grade security, responsible AI governance, and zero fabricated claims.
trust.card1Desc: Documents are stored in private directories with strict token-authenticated stream endpoints. No public URLs, no data leakage.
trust.card2Desc: Policy purchases require cryptographic server-side validation. Policies are only bound upon confirmed transaction verification.
trust.card3Desc: Every risk score is supported by clear evidence, citation references, and verifiable arithmetic calculations.
trust.disclaimer: AI-assisted verification identifies inconsistencies, calculation errors, and risk indicators. It does not guarantee authenticity unless the policy is independently confirmed through an authorized insurer or trusted official source.
